name: IUCN Cat Classification Task Force (2017)
scope: 40 wild species concepts and the domestic cat; pinned to CCTF 2017, not a claim to include every later proposed species.
reference: Kitchener et al. (2017). A revised taxonomy of the Felidae. Cat News Special Issue 11.
profile_sources: IUCN/SSC Cat Specialist Group species accounts; Felidae Conservation Fund for the domestic cat. Brief original paraphrases, with a source URL per record.
limitations: Later taxonomic splits are intentionally not mixed into the 2017 label set.
Identification features are typical comparisons, not exclusive diagnostic keys.
Range descriptions are broad background information, not locations inferred from an uploaded image.
No conservation status, population totals or subspecies claims are included.
